scope: SDevice-only drain-contact boundary, quasi-Fermi endpoint mapping, SG cut flux, and self-consistent feedback audit

contact_cut.definition: an edge with exactly one endpoint in the drain contact node set
contact_cut.contact_boundary_check: compare Vela and imported Sentaurus drain-contact electron quasi-Fermi values against the configured drain bias
contact_cut.endpoint_mapping_check: compare direct endpoint quasi-Fermi drops and secant gradients with exported Sentaurus eGradQuasiFermi and Vela transport-cell-vector drive
contact_cut.current_reconstruction: sum the production SG edge particle line flux over the native drain cut with the ContactCurrent sign convention

frozen_cut_game.allocation: three-factor Shapley allocation of exact frozen drain-cut current changes
frozen_cut_game.full_state_control: replay all imported Sentaurus fields through the unchanged Vela SG operator

self_consistent_feedback.qf_cut_response: reuse the M18 adjoint-weighted drain-contact-cut QF response
self_consistent_feedback.complete_ledger: reuse the M18 mobility, SG secant conductance, QF imbalance, Poisson, SRH, boundary/gauge, and other-carrier ledger
self_consistent_feedback.interpretation: report frozen direct contribution separately from first-order self-consistent operator sensitivity

decision_questions: Do Vela and Sentaurus impose the same electron quasi-Fermi value at drain contact nodes?
Does the remaining QF difference originate at the constrained contact endpoint or the adjacent free interior endpoint?
Does the unchanged Vela SG operator reproduce Sentaurus terminal current when fed the imported Sentaurus state?
How does the exact frozen cut contribution relate to the M18 self-consistent adjoint response?
interpretation_limits: Imported Sentaurus nodal fields share the original TDR node IDs; no spatial interpolation is used.
Sentaurus eGradQuasiFermi is a nodal vector diagnostic and is not assumed to be its private SG face interpolation.
The frozen cut game is exact for the selected hybrid states but is not a self-consistent re-solve.
SG cut-current closure is an acceptance criterion only for Vg>=0.8 V; sub-fA and weak-current mapped-state cancellation is retained only as guarded context.
